Mariana (Support): FYI — VIP customer (acct 89234) reported a refund request created an invoice note instead of running refund_tool. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/2345 :warning:
Jake (SRE): Can you paste the original API payload and any headers? :eyes:
Mariana (Support): Here's the body they sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "89234",
  "intent": "refund",
  "amount": 120.50,
  "currency": "USD",
  "reason": "order cancellation",
  "metadata": {"vip": true}
}
```
Mariana (Support): They didn't include transaction_id; used "customer_id" only.
Sophie (AE): We're seeing autorouter pick invoice_note when only "amount" + "reason" present — invoice_note and refund_tool both accept those fields in function schema.
Ivan (Ops): support-bot logs show: `toolpicker.choose -> candidate: invoice_note (score 0.67), refund_tool (score 0.66)` — edgecase of tie-breaker preferring invoice_note for low-latency path.
support-bot: [auto] request-id=req_0a1b2c path=/v1/funcs autoroute decision=invoice_note details="schema_overlap:amount,reason"
Jake (SRE): Ugh. Can you repro? Steps?
Mariana (Support): Steps to repro:
1) POST /v1/assistant with function_call:auto
2) body same as above
3) ensure no `transaction_id` or `refund_method`
Result: invoice_note created via payments API, customer still charged.
Sophie (AE): Confirmed locally — if you add `intent_details:{"type":"refund"}` or include `transaction_id` router picks refund_tool.
Ivan (Ops): Short-term mitigation: force explicit tool via `preferred_tool":"refund_tool"` header or set router param `bias_refund=0.1` for this account.
Jake (SRE): I'll patch the tie-breaker today: prefer functions with `action`-style param names (transaction_id/refund_method). Also add an experiment to downrank invoice_note for requests with `intent:refund`.
Mariana (Support): Assign to Jake, mark P2, notify account team. I'll reply in ticket with workaround.
Sophie (AE): Also recommend updating function schema to require `invoice_id` for invoice_note (strictness helps). :thumbsup:
Jake (SRE): Thanks. I'll post the PR and a rollout plan. ETA ~3h. :rocket:
Mariana (Support): Great — will update ticket and ping the customer. Thanks team. :pray:
